record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose this. A tally says how many, the strip says which and how, at the cost of one short run of glyphs on a line that is already there.

## Counter-argument

The selector line already carries the phase, stage, landing, and wave information; more glyphs make it harder to read at a glance.

payload.alternatives: the R n/m verified tally only
payload.choice: The main screen shows one glyph per requirement after the R tally for the selected structured phase; clicking it or e opens the Evidence tab

record.subject: evidence-strip
